mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO favorite (user_id, goods_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goodsId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId}

SELECT f.id, f.goods_id, f.create_time, g.name AS goods_name, g.main_image, g.price, g.status, s.name AS shop_name FROM favorite f JOIN goods g ON f.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN shop s ON g.shop_id = s.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId}
